identity: Totemwater Reach reads its future in river knots, and the knots say something old is hungry.

quests.title: A Future Trampled Flat
quests.text: My reading knots speak of something old and hungry beneath the water, but I need fresh reeds to finish the telling. Kill six Reed Tapirs by day in the {name:jungle}, {zone_area:jungle}, where they trample the reeds I use. It is hard enough to read tomorrow without a tapir sitting on it.

quests.title: Our Ancestors Are Not Cushions
quests.text: The carvers leave their totems in the {name:totemwood}, {zone_area:totemwood}, and the Reed Jungle Lynxes promptly curl up on them. Kill six lynxes there by day so the work can continue. An ancestor's face deserves better than a tail across the nose.

quests.title: Read by Restless Light
quests.text: The next knot will not speak clearly by firelight, and I do not care for what that usually means. Bring me two Bound Wisp Motes from the Wandering Wisps in the {name:wispfen} {dir_from_giver:wispfen} after dark. I will read again by wisp-light; you keep your feet on a path you trust.

quests.title: The Name Beneath the Water
quests.text: I have the name at last: Crocodile Reed-Maw, waiting in its dark water {dir_from_giver:reed_maw_crocodile}. It is older than this post, and our fishers have begun to vanish between its jaws. Kill Reed-Maw before another boat comes home with nobody to tie it up.

quests.title: The Knot Toward the Mesa
quests.text: For once, the knots show me a road instead of teeth. Go to Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa and speak with Yarra Standardmender, who holds the Throng's banners against the Accord. I cannot promise you gentle weather up there, but I would trust your hands with whatever the wind brings.

quests.title: A Trap Full of Pincers
quests.text: I set traps for fish, yet the Barnacle Pinchers in the {name:shallows} {dir_from_giver:shallows} seem convinced everything I lower into the water belongs to them. Kill six by day and clear space for our traps. A reading on an empty stomach always seems to predict supper.

quests.title: Optional: Lights Over the Traps
quests.text: After dark the Wandering Wisps drift through the {name:jungle} and lead my fishers off the path to the traps. Put out six of them. The knots say nothing about this one; I simply prefer my fishers to come home the way they left.

quests.title: Put the Shells to Work
quests.text: The Barnacle Pinchers have spent long enough meddling with my traps; now they can contribute something useful. Bring me two Layered Crab Shells from them in the {name:shallows} {dir_from_giver:shallows} by day, and I will make new lids. There is a pleasing turn in that knot.

quests.title: Bounty: What the Tide Brings
quests.text: The tide lays Barnacle Pinchers across the {name:breakers} {dir_from_giver:breakers} as though scattering seeds. Kill six by day for this repeatable bounty. You can take it again twenty minutes after turning it in; no gift of foresight is needed to know I will still want them gone.
